settings.preconditionBody: Python must be installed locally and able to import plugin / config / utils from the neko source directory (python -c "import plugin, config, utils" passes). The neko source directory (default C:\\N.E.K.O-main) is a read-only dependency; this project does not modify it.
settings.boundaryBody: Neko plugin LLM tools are bridged to the CX-O backend over the CXFC protocol: on invocation the backend calls the CXFC /call endpoint, which lands on this machine (Electron tool bridge) and forwards to the plugin for execution. Frontend and backend may run on different machines; tool definitions are captured by the local registration receiver. Prerequisite: the plugin runtime is running locally and plugins have reported their tools.

I am the summary assistant. I will analyze this conversation and generate summary memories.

You can:
1. Ask me to auto summarize
2. Tell me what aspects to focus on
3. Specify importance and timestamp

I will save summaries as structured memories with content, importance(1-10), and timestamp.
